text:
An wallafa 12 Oktoba 2026 Wanda aka sabunta Mintuna 17 da suka wuce Lokacin karatu: Minti 6 Ƴan Najeriya na ci gaba da tsokaci kan sunayen ƴantakarar gwamna da hukumar zaɓen ƙasar INEc ta fitar domin fafatawa a zaɓen 2027.
INEC ta tantance tare da amincewa da Kingsley Chinda a matsayin ɗan takarar gwamnan Jihar Rivers a zaɓen 2027, bayan ta saka sunansa cikin jerin ƴan takarar gwamnoni da ta fitar a daren Asabar.
Kingsley Ogundu Chinda tsohon jagoran yan adawa ne a Majalisar Wakilan Najeriya. sannan kuma tsohon mamba ne na jam'iyyar hamayya ta PDP.
Kingsley Chinda ya fara ɗaukar hankali watanni da suka gabata lokacin da ya zama ɗan takarar gwamnan Jihar Rivers na jam'iyyar All Progressives Congress (APC), alhali jama'a sun san shi a matsayin mamba na jam'iyyar PDP.
Daga nan ne 'yan Najeriya suka fara tambayar lokacin da ya sauya sheƙa zuwa APC, da kuma ko har yanzu shi ne jagoran ƴan adawa a Majalisar Wakilai.
6 Yuli 2026 Yadda INEC za ta yi amfani da AI a zaɓen Najeriya na 2027 28 Satumba 2026 Fitattun ƴan siyasa huɗu da babu sunansu a ƴan takarar gwamna na INEC 11 Oktoba 2026 End of content
Bayan hukuncin da Kotun Ƙoli ta yanke a ranar 24 ga Satumba, 2026, sunan Kingsley Chinda ya sake ɗaukar hankali, sakamakon yadda hukuncin ya mayar da wasu tanade-tanaden Dokar Zaɓe ta 2026 da aka soke a baya.
Kotun Ƙolin ta yanke hukunci kan tanade-tanaden Dokar Zaɓen 2026 da suka shafi rijistar membobin jam'iyyun siyasa da kuma tsayar da 'yan takara.
Kwamitin alƙalai bakwai da Mai Shari'a Adamu Jauro ya jagoranta ya soke hukuncin Kotun Ɗaukaka Ƙara da ya warware sashe na 77(5), 77(6), 77(7) da kuma 84(2) na dokar.
Waɗannan sassa na dokar sun shafi ƙa'idojin da suka danganci rijistar mambobin jam'iyyun siyasa, zaɓen fidda gwani kai tsaye, ko kuma tsarin maslaha wajen zaɓen yan takara da jam'iyyu ke amfani da shi.
Sakamakon wannan hukunci na Kotun Ƙoli, wata ƙungiya mai suna Association of Legislative Drafting and Advocacy Practitioners (ALDRAP) ta buƙaci Hukumar Zaɓe Mai Zaman Kanta ta Ƙasa (INEC) ta hana Kingsley Chinda tsayawa takarar gwamnan Jihar Rivers a ƙarƙashin jam'iyyar APC a zaɓen 2027.
Ƙungiyar ta roƙi INEC da ta binciki "halaccin zaɓen fidda gwani na APC na takarar gwamna, sharuɗɗan da suka shafi rijistar mambobi, bayanan da APC ta miƙa wa INEC, da kuma matakan da suka dace domin aiwatar da hukuncin Kotun Ƙoli."
Duk da wannan ce-ce-ku-cen, jam'iyyar APC a Jihar Rivers ta bayyana cewa "ba mu da wata matsala", yayin da take mayar da martani kan sauya shekar ɗan takararta, Kingsley Chinda, zuwa jam'iyyar.
Da yake yanzu INEC ta fitar da jerin sunayen ƴan takara, hakan na nuna cewa babu wata matsala da ta hana shi tsayawa takara, kuma zai ci gaba da kasancewa ɗan takarar gwamnan Jihar Rivers na jam'iyyar APC a zaɓen shekarar 2027.
Kotu ce ta buƙaci INEC ta dakata da saka sunan Abdulsalam Gwarzo a matsayin ɗan takarar NDC har sai ta kammala sauraron shari'a.
